name: docker-mcp-server
description: Manage Docker through the Docker SDK for Python and the docker CLI: containers, images, networks, volumes, Compose, Swarm, Buildx, Scout, and OCI registries, exposed as MCP tools.

docker_hosts.title: Docker host(s)
docker_hosts.description: Docker daemon(s) to manage. Blank = your default Docker context / socket. One remote: ssh://user@host (recommended; auth via your SSH keys), tcp://host:2375 for a plaintext TCP daemon, or tcp://host:2376(tls=/path/to/certs) for a TLS daemon (the directory needs ca.pem, which verifies the daemon - a self-signed daemon works - plus cert.pem/key.pem only if it requires a client cert). Several: comma-separated name=endpoint pairs, e.g. local=auto, prod=ssh://ops@prod.example.com(ro) - append (ro) to make a host read-only, or (nd) to block only destructive calls (kills/removals/prunes) on it. When set, this replaces DOCKER_HOST.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Register only read-only tools - no create, modify, or delete.

no_destructive.title: Disable destructive tools
no_destructive.description: Register everything except destructive tools (remove / prune / kill).

disable_domains.title: Disabled domains
disable_domains.description: Comma-separated tool domains to drop, e.g. swarm,plugins,scout.
